# Research Templates

Use these templates to keep Omega01 research comparable, reviewable, and reproducible.

- [Research Ticket](research-ticket-template.md): PM task framing.
- [Strategy Spec](strategy-spec-template.md): Research handoff to Quant Dev.
- [Experiment Log](experiment-log-template.md): run-level metadata and results.
- [Backtest Report](backtest-report-template.md): serious result summary.
- [Risk Review](risk-review-template.md): drawdown, exposure, sizing, and guardrails.
- [Critic Review](critic-review-template.md): adversarial review.
- [Decision Log](decision-log-template.md): PM decision record.
